rival_explanations.statement: A route with one agent produces no handoff, so the cell is NOT_OBSERVED rather than failed and a run that never delegated cannot be told apart from one whose handoffs were clean.

cells.title: Error recognition
cells.claim: The operator notices an injected failure, classifies it correctly, opens the evidence, and does not let work continue past a stop.
cells.observable: run events -> checkpoint raised -> operator turn -> number of evidence inspections, the state change chosen, and whether work continued after a stop

rival_explanations.statement: One checkpoint window decides all four opportunities in this cell.
rival_explanations.mitigation: The opportunity count and distribution are reported beside the estimate.

cells.title: Appropriate reliance on AI advice
cells.claim: Incorrect AI advice is rejected on the evidence, and correct AI advice is adopted.
cells.observable: independent initial judgment -> initial confidence -> delegation decision -> AI advice with known oracle correctness -> inspection -> adopt, reject or modify -> final judgment -> verified outcome

rival_explanations.statement: A rejection may follow from not understanding the advice rather than from evaluating it.
rival_explanations.mitigation: Domain familiarity is a declared facet and must be recorded with every observation of this cell.

rival_explanations.statement: Adoption may follow from the cost of disagreeing with the interface rather than from agreement with the advice.
rival_explanations.mitigation: The interface facet must be recorded; comparison across interfaces is withheld until invariance evidence exists.

rival_explanations.statement: If the correctness of the advice is inferable from the task surface, the episode measures the leak rather than the reliance decision.
rival_explanations.mitigation: The task model requires a declared oracle and a shortcut prohibition; neither is verified by this contract.

rival_explanations.statement: Advice that reads as confident is adopted more often independently of correctness, so an operator faced with plausible wrong advice is not comparable to one faced with implausible wrong advice.
rival_explanations.mitigation: Advice plausibility is not a declared facet and no evidence controls it.

cells.title: Confidence and correctness calibration
cells.claim: Stated confidence tracks the correctness of the judgment it is stated about.
cells.observable: initial confidence -> final confidence -> verified correctness of the final judgment, per episode

rival_explanations.statement: Confidence on its own earns no credit; a well calibrated operator on an easy set is not distinguishable from an overconfident one until difficulty is controlled.

rival_explanations.statement: A confidence scale with few points compresses real differences into the same value.
rival_explanations.mitigation: None. No scale has been specified and none is asserted here.

cells.claim: The verification that produced the outcome ran outside the assessed process, on code the assessed run could not change, and returned a verdict for every probe.

rival_explanations.statement: The verdict is trusted because it carries a nonce, so anything that could read the nonce could author a verdict.
rival_explanations.mitigation: The nonce is deleted from the environment before the assessed module is loaded, which is the control; it is not a proof.

cells.title: Exact revision binding
